name: Broad admin-health prompt surfaces admin insights
description: Regression case for W-23757364 (PR #840). Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and a site-admin PAT. A broad, un-hinted admin-health prompt (no role self-declaration, no tool name) must lead the model to proactively invoke query-admin-insights rather than answer generically. FAILS on a pre-fix build (no server initialize instructions block → tool not surfaced) and PASSES only on a PR-#840 build that emits the ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED instructions block. LLM-mediated, so treat as a pass-rate over N>=5 runs, not a single pass. Read-only, no mutation.
prompt: Give me a health check of this Tableau site — anything I should clean up or worry about?
